financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of common stock under 2021 Sales Agreement from Oct 1, 2023 through the financial statements date
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From October 1, 2023 through the date of these financial statements, the Company sold 3,254,943 shares of common stock under the 2021 Sales Agreement for net proceeds of $1.6 million.
